transformation.position: Packed point tensor before model data preprocessing, voxelization and fusion camera-depth construction
transformation.population: Keyframe plus loaded preceding LiDAR sweeps
transformation.algorithm: Per token, seed NumPy PCG64 from the first eight bytes of SHA-256 of UTF-8 text '20261002:' + sample_token, interpreted as an unsigned big-endian integer. Generate one permutation of N row indices. For fraction f retain its first max(1, floor(f*N)) indices, sorted to preserve original row order.
